crossRefs.note: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

parallels.note: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done…

translations.web: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
translations.bsb: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
translations.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
translations.asv: and if I ask you, ye will not answer.
